text:
maria_p: Quick proposal for marketplace + SI claim SLAs to prevent churned handoffs. Idea: enforce a 'claim token' workflow so partners must explicitly take a claim within X hours or AE retains ownership. Thoughts?
ravi_k: Love token idea. Operationally: token = 1 claim per account per SI partner. Token lifetime 72h by default but make it configurable per partner tier.
sophie_sales: From AE POV: need auto-notify in CRM and no silent transfers. If token not claimed -> AE gets a 'finalize' task and a notification to follow up within 24h.
kevin_r: RevOps can add SFDC fields: partner_claim_token, token_expires_at, claim_state. Automation rule triggers reminders: 48h + 24h before expire. Can also block marketplace announcement until claim_state != pending.
tara_pm: Announcement gating: require four items before a joint public announcement: 1) Signed MOU or LOI, 2) Approved co-branded assets, 3) Joint demo in sandbox, 4) Marketing contact and publish window. Legal: is lightweight MOU ok?
legal_bot: Legal recommends a two-page MOU for standard co-sell that covers logo use, mutual PR approval window (72h), and data sharing boundaries. Legal review SLA: 3 business days for standard partners.
maria_p: Adding account-mapping rules: if SI has had an active engagement (PO, SOW, or proof-of-concept) in last 9 months -> SI gets auto-priority for claim token. Otherwise token assignment defaults to partnerships/sales intake. Also maintain a 'no-claim' list for top-10 strategic accounts.
ravi_k: Suggest encode that as a check: previous_engagement_last_n_months >= 9 -> auto-assign token to SI. Also include ARR threshold: if ARR_estimate > 100k -> route to 'co-owned' by default.
sophie_sales: Can we add a short UX for AEs: a single-click 'contest claim' button that triggers an arbitration ping to partnerships if there's a dispute? Saves back-and-forth.
kevin_r: We can add a button that creates a case in PRJ-claims and notifies partnerships channel. Pseudo-automation snippet for SFDC: ```if partner_claim_token == null and intake_channel == "marketplace": create_token(); send_notification("@SI_partner_manager"); start_timer(72h)```
tara_pm: Pilot suggestion: run with two marketplace partners + one hardware partner for 4 weeks. Measure: % of handoffs with claim accepted, avg time-to-claim, AE follow-up actions.
maria_p: Metrics good. Also track announcement delays caused by missing MOU or security checklist items. Need a small press checklist template we can attach to intake.
legal_bot: I'll attach a draft MOU + press checklist to PRJ-claims within 48h.
ravi_k: One more guardrail: limit concurrent active tokens per SI to 15 to avoid spammy claiming across thousands of small accounts. Partners above Platinum get higher quota.
sophie_sales: For partner-marketed leads that originate from marketplace discovery (no AE), token auto-assigns to partnerships to triage and assign.
kevin_r: Creating ticket PRJ-2345 to implement fields + button + token quota controls. ETA for pilot-ready automation = 7 business days. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PRJ-2345
maria_p: Great. I'll build the intake + announcement checklist and post the pilot runbook in channel tomorrow morning. If anyone wants to join the working group, reply here.
sophie_sales: I'm in.
tara_pm: I'll coordinate partner communications for pilot enrollments.
legal_bot: MOU draft incoming.
